notes: First FDA-approved therapy for SMA (2016-12-23). 2'-MOE ASO targeting ISS-N1 in SMN2 intron 7.
Phosphorodiamidate morpholino ASO; exon 51 skipping for DMD amenable mutations. Accelerated approval 2016-09-19.
PMO ASO; exon 53 skipping for DMD. Accelerated approval 2019-12-12.
PMO ASO; exon 45 skipping for DMD. Accelerated approval 2021-02-25.
2'-MOE/PS ASO targeting TTR mRNA; approved for hATTR amyloidosis with polyneuropathy 2018-10-05.
2'-MOE/PS ASO targeting APOC3 mRNA; FDA approved 2023 for familial partial lipodystrophy (FPL). EU approval for FCS.
2'-MOE/PS ASO targeting SOD1 mRNA; accelerated approval 2023-04-25 for ALS with SOD1 mutation.
GalNAc-conjugated ASO targeting hepatic TTR; approved 2023-12-21 for hATTR amyloidosis with polyneuropathy.
LNP-formulated siRNA targeting TTR; first RNAi therapeutic FDA-approved (2018-08-10) for hATTR polyneuropathy.
GalNAc-siRNA targeting ALAS1 mRNA in hepatocytes; approved 2019-11-20 for acute hepatic porphyria (AHP).
GalNAc-siRNA targeting HAO1 (glycolate oxidase); approved 2020-11-23 for primary hyperoxaluria type 1 (PH1).
GalNAc-siRNA targeting PCSK9 mRNA; approved 2021-12-22 for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia and clinical ASCVD.
GalNAc-siRNA targeting TTR; approved 2022-06-13 for hATTR amyloidosis with polyneuropathy. SC quarterly dosing.
GalNAc-siRNA targeting antithrombin (SERPINC1); approved 2023-03-28 for hemophilia A and B (with and without inhibitors).
CFTR potentiator; approved 2012-01-31 for CF patients ≥2y with G551D or other responsive gating/residual-function mutations.
CFTR corrector (lumacaftor) + potentiator (ivacaftor) combination; approved 2015-07-02 for CF F508del homozygous.
Triple CFTR modulator (next-gen corrector + corrector + potentiator); approved 2019-10-21 for CF with ≥1 F508del allele.
AAV9-delivered functional SMN1 transgene; approved 2019-05-24 for SMA in patients <2y with biallelic SMN1 loss.
Lentiviral gene therapy adding functional βA-T87Q-globin in autologous HSCs; approved 2022-08-17 for transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia.
CRISPR-Cas9 editing of BCL11A erythroid enhancer in autologous HSCs, derepressing HbF. First CRISPR therapy FDA-approved 2023-12-08 (SCD) and 2024-01-16 (TDT).
Lentiviral gene therapy with anti-sickling HbAT87Q-globin in autologous HSCs; approved 2023-12-08 for SCD.
AAVrh74-delivered micro-dystrophin transgene; accelerated approval 2023-06-22 for ambulatory DMD patients 4-5y with confirmed DMD mutation.
Recombinant acid alpha-glucosidase; approved 2006-04-28 for Pompe disease. Lumizyme approved 2010 for late-onset Pompe in patients ≥8y.
High-M6P recombinant GAA with enhanced lysosomal targeting; approved 2021-08-06 for late-onset Pompe disease.
Recombinant human alpha-galactosidase A; approved 2003-04-24 for Fabry disease.
PEGylated recombinant alpha-galactosidase A dimer with extended half-life; approved 2023-05-09 for Fabry disease.
Recombinant human alpha-L-iduronidase; approved 2003-04-30 for MPS I (Hurler, Hurler-Scheie, Scheie syndromes).
Recombinant human iduronate-2-sulfatase; approved 2006-07-24 for MPS II (Hunter syndrome) in male patients.
Recombinant human N-acetylgalactosamine 4-sulfatase; approved 2005-05-31 for MPS VI (Maroteaux-Lamy syndrome).
Recombinant human N-acetylgalactosamine-6-sulfatase; approved 2014-02-14 for MPS IVA (Morquio A syndrome).
Recombinant human beta-glucuronidase; approved 2017-11-15 for MPS VII (Sly syndrome).
Recombinant human tripeptidyl peptidase 1 (TPP1) administered intraventricularly; approved 2017-04-27 for CLN2 neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis.
Recombinant human lysosomal acid lipase produced in transgenic eggs; approved 2015-12-08 for LAL deficiency (Wolman disease and CESD).
Bone-targeted recombinant human tissue-nonspecific alkaline phosphatase fusion protein; approved 2015-10-23 for perinatal, infantile, and juvenile-onset hypophosphatasia.
Iminosugar pharmacological chaperone that binds and stabilises misfolded GLA variants amenable to chaperoning; approved 2018-08-10 for Fabry disease.
Synthetic tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), cofactor for PAH; acts as pharmacological chaperone for BH4-responsive PAH variants. Approved 2007-12-16 for PKU.
Farnesyltransferase inhibitor; approved 2020-11-20 for Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome and processing-deficient progeroid laminopathies. Prevents farnesylation of progerin.
Oral SMN2 splicing modifier; approved 2020-08-07 for SMA across all ages and types. Stabilises SMN2 exon 7 inclusion by interacting with U1-snRNP and SRSF1.
Anti-FGF23 monoclonal antibody (IgG1); approved 2018-04-17 for X-linked hypophosphatemia. Blocks FGF23-mediated phosphate wasting.
Anti-IL-1β fully human IgG1 mAb; approved 2009-06-17 for cryopyrin-associated periodic syndromes (CAPS) caused by NLRP3 gain-of-function variants.
Anti-C1s IgG4 mAb; first FDA-approved treatment for cold agglutinin disease (CAD), 2022-02-04. Selectively inhibits classical complement pathway.
HbS polymerization inhibitor; approved 2019-11-25 for sickle cell disease. VOLUNTARILY WITHDRAWN from all markets by Pfizer 2024-09-25 following inconclusive phase 3 data.
MC4R agonist peptide; approved 2020-11-27 for chronic weight management in adults/children ≥6y with POMC, PCSK1, or LEPR deficiency obesity.
PEGylated recombinant Anabaena variabilis phenylalanine ammonia lyase; approved 2018-05-24 for PKU. Degrades phenylalanine as functional PAH substitute.
Oral CXCR4 antagonist; approved 2024-04-26 for WHIM syndrome (gain-of-function CXCR4 variants). Restores neutrophil and lymphocyte mobilisation.
Ileal bile acid transporter (IBAT/SLC10A2) inhibitor; approved 2021-09-29 for cholestatic pruritus in Alagille syndrome (JAG1/NOTCH2 mutations).
IBAT inhibitor (SLC10A2); approved 2021-07-20 for pruritus in progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis (PFIC) types 1 and 2.
Dual endothelin type-A (ETa) and angiotensin II type-1 (AT1) receptor antagonist; approved 2023-02-17 for IgA nephropathy. Reduces proteinuria.

Small-molecule chaperone that clears misfolded MUC1 frameshift protein (MUC1-fs) from the ER via TMED9; identified by Bhatt lab (Harvard). Not FDA-approved. PMID: 33627739 (Science 2021).
